title: fix(driver-sql): name the safe column entries' remedy per object kind
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoH1SLb7yGpZj1NnaFvhbT6W)_
Fixes #33836

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:开发者在迁移计划里看到的三类安全列提示,改为按对象来源分别说明怎么处理;本环境创建的对象仍是发布即生效,软件包提供的对象只指向迁移应用命令。
- 为什么做:收尾非空约束提示按对象来源说明的那项工作,同类的三条提示还在叫软件包对象去发布,而软件包对象根本不能在此发布。
- 出错会怎样:只改提示文字,不改任何迁移行为;万一措辞不当,只是提示读起来不准,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts`: the `safe` column entries of a declared field (`widen_date_to_datetime`, `widen_varchar`, `drop_column_default`) now end with one shared sentence, `SAFE_COLUMN_REMEDY`, that names the act per object kind the way the `relax_not_null` message does: "For an object authored in this environment, publishing the object applies it; for an object a package provides (sealed, so it cannot be published here), run "os migrate apply", which applies it for either kind."

Only `os migrate apply` is named for a package object because a publish of one is refused and its managed install has no door for these ops (`relaxDeclaredNotNull` applies the declared NOT NULL relax only). Text only: no op category, reconciler arm or conversion moves.

Premise, measured at `fddb9cbb`: the card says all three entries carried "... publishing the object applies it, or run "os migrate apply"." Only `widen_date_to_datetime` did. `widen_varchar` said `widen via "os migrate".` (a command group, not the act), and `drop_column_default` said `run "os migrate apply".` (true for both kinds but silent on the publish that applies it to an environment-authored object). All three now carry the same per-kind sentence. The relax_not_null text learns no object kind at run time either: it names both kinds in one message, and this reuses that shape, so no detector was added.

## Tests

- New top-level `describe` in the existing harness `schema-drift.remedy-sentence.test.ts` (pins for this component go into its shared harness file): each of the three ops, on postgres, is `safe`, carries the per-kind sentence, no longer carries the old one, and comes back unchanged from `driftFindingWithoutRemedy`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql test` at `dc14e1e5`: Test Files 268 passed, 13 skipped (281); Tests 4504 passed, 260 skipped. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) clean. Existing pins that quote "publishing the object applies it" still hold.
- Ablation, once (the behaviour the pin holds changed): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the old `widen via "os migrate".` back into the `widen_varchar` message (anchor 1 to 0, blob f9f967f2 to 5c65b0ff); the pin went red on `widen_varchar` alone; restore proved blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./schema-drift` from source, so no `dist/` step applies.

## Acceptance notes

- The op docblock for `widen_date_to_datetime` still reads "A publish of the object applies it"; it describes the publish door, which is true for the object kinds that can publish, so it is left as it is.

## Verification

Read first: `schema-drift.ts`, the `SAFE_COLUMN_REMEDY` constant and the three messages that use it.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/schema-drift.remedy-sentence.test.ts` prints 8 passed.

<details><summary>Derived gate families (67), local at dc14e1e5</summary>

`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` with exit codes: 67 derived, 64 run with exit 0, 3 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met in this worktree: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` need the full build, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallow clone). CI carries those three.

</details>
